document.abstract: The Panel Discussion was held on Juanary 31, 1970 as the concluding session of the Winter Television Conference at Atlanta, Ga. The panelists had previously received questions on various aspects of videotape recording. Many questions dealt directly with the specifics of operational and maintenance problems. Other questions, such as those on standardization and videotape recording theory, were given special study by the panelists to provide a discussion in depth of the theoretical and scientific aspects of videotape recording as well as the technical problems.
